name: set_reminder
description: Set a reminder for the current user to notify them later  with a custom message

time.description: Amount of time to wait before reminding (e.g., 5, 10, 60)

unit.description: The time unit for the reminder (e.g., 'minutes', 'hours', 'days')

message.description: The reminder text. Can be void or empty for a default reminder message.
